subject: Design freelance pool — renewal, SOW update & onboarding timeline
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@lumencreative.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Miles <jordan@lumencreative.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: design freelance pool renewal + SOW for 2027

Hi Evelyn,

Hope you're well — it was great catching up at the product showcase last month. Per our conversation, attached is a refreshed statement of work (SOW_Draft_v3.pdf) to extend Lumen's freelance design pool services for Redwood through Q1 2027. High-level summary below: 

- Scope: 6 on-demand senior designers + 8 vetted contractors for short-term assignments (ads, landing pages, event creative).
- Hours: guaranteed 1,200 hrs/month pooled capacity; overages billed at hourly rates in attached rate card.
- Onboarding: two-week benching + profile packets for each contractor; Slack channel + kickoff doc.
- SLAs: 48-hour turnaround for small requests, 5 business days for mid-size projects.
- Pricing: blended monthly retainer with usage overage; see Lumen_rate_card_2026.xlsx.

We can accommodate the budget constraints you mentioned and push a faster onboarding if you want a Dec 15 go-live. Let me know if the SOW needs redlines or if legal/procurement want a separate version.

Best,

Elaine Park
Head of Partnerships, Lumen Creative Collective
[attachment: SOW_Draft_v3.pdf - PDF]
[attachment: Lumen_rate_card_2026.xlsx - Spreadsheet]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@lumencreative.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: design freelance pool renewal + SOW for 2027

Thanks Elaine — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear summary. I took a pass with a few priority asks before I loop procurement: 

1) Rate clarity: can you provide explicit blended and per-hour examples for a typical monthly mix (e.g., 60% senior, 40% mid) so we can plug numbers into the forecast?
2) Ownership/IP: please add a clause that any creative deliverable commissioned by Redwood transfers IP on final delivery (standard work-for-hire).
3) PO/term: can we set a 6-month initial term with an auto-extension unless we opt out 30 days before renewal?
4) Onboarding: we want the contractor profiles and sample deliverables two business days before any kickoff.

If you can incorporate those edits we can move to procurement review (Marcus) and legal (Laura). Dec 15 is tight but possible if procurement approves by ~Nov 20.

Small ask: can you annotate the SOW with short comments where you made pricing changes? Saves time for procurement.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Brand & Marketing Programs | Redwood Inference
[mobile: (415) 555-0142]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:36:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Proposal: design freelance pool renewal + SOW for 2027

Evelyn — tagging in procurement notes. Quick internal checklist before we send to Acme Finance for PO: 

- Confirmed monthly blended estimate needed (Evelyn requested example mix).
- Request that term be 6 months with auto-extend opt-out at 30 days (ok from finance side, need legal review for auto-extension language).
- Need W-9 and proof of insurance from Lumen (standard).
- Please confirm whether Lumen accepts Redwood standard payment terms (Net30) or requires Net45.

Also: we have a Q4 spend cap that requires any new ongoing retainer > $60k/month to go through VP approval. If the blended numbers push us above that, I'll flag for Sarah. Can you ask Lumen for candidate start dates and whether they can pause onboarding until PO is issued?

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@lumencreative.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: design freelance pool renewal + SOW for 2027

Elaine — quick follow-up after procurement's checklist. A couple items for SOW revision: 

- Please add blended pricing examples for a 60/40 senior-to-mid mix and an 80/20 mix with monthly projected cost lines. (Marcus needs to model this against Q4 cap.)
- Insert the IP/work-for-hire clause (Laura, can you propose language if needed).
- Confirm Lumen's payment terms (Net30 preferred).
- We need a single-page onboarding plan that lists deliverables and the names/email addresses of the 6 guaranteed designers.

If you can return an annotated SOW and a short onboarding one-pager by Nov 24, I can push this through to Marcus for budget gating. Dec 15 start remains our target but contingent on PO and profiles.

Thanks — Evelyn

On Fri, Nov 6, 2026 at 09:12 AM Elaine Park <elaine@lumencreative.com> wrote:
> Hi Evelyn,
> 
> Following up on the SOW I sent. Happy to add the examples and IP clause — we typically accept work-for-hire but will confirm with legal. Will send annotated SOW and onboarding one-pager by end of week.
> 
> Best,
> Elaine

From: Elaine Park <elaine@lumencreative.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Miles <jordan@lumencreative.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: design freelance pool renewal + SOW for 2027

Hi Evelyn / team — thanks for the checklist. Attached are: 1) SOW_Draft_v3_annotated.pdf with inline pricing examples for 60/40 and 80/20 mixes, 2) onboarding_onepager.pdf with designer names and sample deliverables, and 3) Lumen_W9.pdf.

Summary of decisions and next steps: 
- Blended monthly estimate (60/40): $48,600/month; (80/20): $56,200/month. Overages billed per rate card.
- We accept Redwood's work-for-hire language; added clause on p.5.
- Payment terms: Net30 accepted.
- We can provision contractor profiles within 48 hours of PO issuance; if you need profiles earlier we can share anonymized portfolios immediately.
- Target kickoff: Dec 15, 2026 — Lumen requests PO by Nov 30 to hit that date.

If everything looks good Marcus, can you confirm the PO timeline? If legal needs further edits we can fast-track. Once PO is confirmed we'll send a DocuSign link for the SOW.

Cheers,

Elaine Park
Head of Partnerships | Lumen Creative Collective
